An invited developer pilot · experience concept

Think aloud. Make it visible.

Three short cases invite you to show how you reason through an unfamiliar problem, a software design decision and a team challenge.

Up to 10 recorded minutes per case· Provisional feedback about your answers

The challenge at a glance

01 / REASON

Unfamiliar problems

Explore possibilities, question assumptions and explain your reasoning.

02 / DESIGN

Software architecture

Weigh product constraints, technical tradeoffs and likely failure modes.

03 / COOPERATE

Working with others

Explain how a team could make decisions and share responsibility.

This pilot does not produce a hiring decision, rank or personality profile.

Before the first case

Know what you are choosing.

The challenge and optional research have separate purposes. The live service must show the exact approved notice, retention and assistance rules before you continue.

Challenge processingNeeded for the offered practice, recording, transcript and feedback. This illustration does not collect data.
Optional research useA separate choice about using eligible answer evidence in the registered study.
Optional follow-upA separate choice about being contacted later.
What happens if I decline research?

Declining optional research must not remove access to the offered challenge feedback under the approved service purpose.

What if recording is difficult for me?

The live experience must show available response modes and a support route before a scored case begins.

A practice step comes first

Check your camera and microphone, choose an offered mode and try an unscored prompt. Device or connection problems should lead to recovery or support, never a zero score.

Preview only · no camera permission or submission

The case, allowed help and recording state stay visible. The server sets the time. If the connection fails, the live service must show what was preserved and how to recover.

After review

Feedback you can inspect.

Observations point to evidence in your answer and a next practice step. Missing or unusable evidence stays visible as missing; it is never silently scored zero.

EXAMPLE OBSERVATION

Tradeoff explanation

Qualitative · provisional · human review required

You named contention around a shared account row and proposed partitioning. The answer did not explain which consistency guarantee the alternative preserves.

In the live report, this observation links to a corrected transcript span and the exact rubric version.

Try next

Take one design option and state the invariant it protects, its latency cost and a failure you would test.

Why no total score or percentile?

One case per session has not been shown to support a stable ranking or hiring decision. This pilot defaults to evidence-linked qualitative feedback.
